table.title: API 错误码排查对照表
table.html:
错误码错误信息含义解决办法
40013INVALID_APPID请求携带的 AppID 不合法，常见于拼写错误、误用其他应用的 AppID，或公众号、小程序主体与接口不匹配。登录微信公众平台，在“设置与开发-基本配置”中复制 AppID，与代码、配置中心及各环境变量逐项比对；检查是否误用了同项目下其他应用的凭据。服务商代调用时确认授权方 AppID 与授权关系一致，修改后清除本地缓存并重新获取 access_token 再试。
40001INVALID_CREDENTIALaccess_token 无效、已过期或不是最新值；同一账号在别处刷新后，旧 token 会提前失效。统一由服务端集中获取并缓存 token，按 expires_in 提前 5 分钟刷新；避免多实例各自刷新，使用 Redis 等共享缓存并加分布式锁。检查请求参数是否把 access_token 放在 query 中、是否被 URL 编码破坏；确认没有混用其他应用的 token。若刚重置 AppSecret，需重新获取 token。
48001API_UNAUTHORIZED当前账号未获得该接口权限，可能因公众号未认证、权限集未开通、接口已下线或调用主体类型不符。在公众平台“接口权限”中核对账号类型与认证状态，确认目标接口对应该账号开放；服务商需检查第三方平台权限集是否勾选并重新授权。若接口已调整或下线，改用官方推荐的替代接口；小程序端还需确认类目和权限申请已通过，避免用测试号调用正式权限接口。
45009API_FREQ_LIMIT接口调用超过当日或每分钟配额，触发频率限制；共享同一 AppID 的服务会合并计算。查看公众平台“接口调用频次”及返回头中的限额信息，定位高频来源并增加本地缓存、合并请求与异步重试；重试采用指数退避，避免整点集中刷新 token。多业务共用账号时按优先级拆分调用或申请独立账号，必要时联系微信调整配额，切勿通过轮换 AppID 绕过限制。
40125INVALID_APPSECRETAppSecret 不正确或已失效，通常发生在重置密钥后旧配置未同步，或复制时混入空格、换行。到“设置与开发-基本配置”重置 AppSecret，立即更新配置中心、密钥管理服务和各环境变量，重启相关服务并清理旧 token 缓存。核对代码中是否硬编码了历史密钥，检查 CI/CD 注入值与线上实际值是否一致；重置会使旧 Secret 立即失效，应安排在低峰期并提前通知协作方。
40003INVALID_OPENIDOpenID 格式错误、不属于当前 AppID，或用户已注销、取消关注导致无法定位。确认 OpenID 来自当前公众号或小程序的授权流程，避免跨应用混用；检查数据库字段长度与编码，排除前后空格及被截断的情况。若用户已注销，应引导重新授权获取新 OpenID；批量任务先调用用户信息接口校验有效性，对无效值记录日志并跳过，不要反复重试。
40029INVALID_CODEOAuth2 授权 code 不合法、已过期或已被使用；code 通常一次性有效且有效期较短。检查网页授权回调是否重复消费同一 code，确保拿到 code 后立即在服务端换取 access_token；不要在前端缓存或多次转发。核对 redirect_uri 与后台配置完全一致，排除 URL 编码差异；分布式部署时避免并发换取，可对 code 加短期锁。过期后让用户重新发起授权，不要用旧 code 重试。

rounds.insights: The first two columns are lookup keys: keeping the numeric codes and error identifiers intact makes the initial viewport useful even when the rest requires scrolling. The fitting layouts expose every column but cannot preserve the longest identifiers or technical terms at 360px; their tradeoffs need to be judged separately. Measured word-break counts do not by themselves establish which breaks are most disruptive. Proposed widths are hypotheses and require rendered verification.

synthesis.rationale: s2A preserves complete error identifiers and gives the meaning and solution columns readable line lengths; its seven data rows also have a consistent height. s2C is the strongest fitting candidate because it gives the longest prose the most space, limiting the tallest cell to 19 lines, though its split identifiers and narrow text columns are serious compromises. It is included as the best fitting option for independent acceptance, not as an endorsement equivalent to s2A.

general: Size lookup fields to keep identifiers intact where possible, and give long prose enough width for continuous reading.
Judge a scrolling table both as a whole and in its initial viewport; access to later columns is part of its function.
Compare actual line breaks and row relationships rather than treating equal widths, height, or a break count as a goal in itself.
specific: A 175 px error-message column accommodates this table's longest identifier including padding.
At 360 px, the fitting candidates cannot preserve all technical units and still give the solution text a comfortable measure.
The scrolling candidates initially show both identifier columns but require horizontal movement to read the complete meaning and solution.

synthesis.tradeoffs: s2A requires 661 px of horizontal travel and the solution is outside the initial viewport. s2C avoids horizontal scrolling but has 105 measured breaks inside words, a wrapped header, and much taller rows. P, s3A and R are publishable scrolling alternatives; their different widths change breaks and row heights without eliminating the need to scroll.
synthesis.uncertain: The measured word-break counts do not establish the severity of each break. s2C is only a conditional fitting finalist: its acceptance depends on whether avoiding horizontal scrolling outweighs the visibly fragmented identifiers and prose for the intended readers.

d1r4A.idea: 尝试较紧凑的滚动布局：保留完整的两个查找入口，缩短横向移动距离，同时给含义和解决办法保留明显大于适屏方案的宽度；检验新增换行是否值得。

d1r4B.idea: 尝试适屏方案中的折中分配：比d1r0A增加错误信息列宽度，同时保留比d1r3B更宽的含义列；检验标识拆分、行高和长文阅读之间的实际取舍。

d2r5A.idea: Test a fitting layout that gives the error identifiers more room while retaining a usable solution column. The meaning column becomes narrow, so compare its breaks and row heights against d2r4A.

d2r5B.idea: Test a scrolling compromise between d2r4B and d2r4C: preserve complete lookup identifiers, give the remedy more room than in B, and reduce horizontal travel relative to C.

d2r5C.idea: Keep approximately the same total width as d2r3C while shifting space from solutions to meanings. Test whether fewer awkward breaks and better balance between the two explanatory columns offset any increase in row height.

d3r5A.idea: 滚动方案：保持错误码和英文标识完整，将含义列收窄至仍可容纳最长技术标识，并给解决办法接近一个手机视口的宽度；测试较短横向滚动与行高之间的折中。

d3r5B.idea: 适屏方案：提高错误信息列宽度以减少英文标识的碎片化，保留解决办法基本阅读宽度；测试以更紧的含义列换取更可靠的错误核对是否值得。

d3r5C.idea: 适屏方案：在两个现有适屏设计之间重新分配宽度，使表头保持单行并增加解决办法空间，同时观察含义列变窄后的行高和技术词断行。

d1r5A.idea: 滚动方案：保留完整标识，将部分宽度从含义移给最长的解决办法；检验能否在接近 d1r0C 总宽的情况下改善步骤阅读和断行。

d1r5B.idea: 较紧凑的滚动方案：保留完整错误标识，缩短横向滚动距离，同时给解决办法更多空间；检验含义列收窄后的可读性。

d1r5C.idea: 适配视口方案：给错误信息和解决办法更多宽度，尝试减少标识与操作步骤的断裂；含义列会更窄，需检验这一取舍是否值得。

s0A.idea: Scrolling candidate: retain P's intact lookup columns, move 20px from meaning to solution, and keep the same overall width. The added solution width may reduce disruptive wraps while the meaning column remains usable; verify whether any meaning cells become taller.

s0B.idea: Scrolling candidate: preserve complete lookup keys while narrowing both prose columns relative to P. This reduces horizontal travel and brings the solution column closer to the initial viewport, at the likely cost of taller rows; check whether the resulting paragraphs remain readable.

s0C.idea: Viewport-fitting candidate: give error identifiers more room than Q, while keeping a relatively generous solution column. The meaning column becomes very narrow, so test the actual breaks and height; intact long identifiers are still impossible at this width.

s1A.idea: 保持 P 的总宽，继续把少量宽度移给含义列，检验能否进一步减少词内断行，同时观察解决办法是否增加行高。

s1B.idea: 保留 P 的含义列，扩大解决办法列，检验额外横向滚动能否换来更自然的技术词换行或更少的行数。

s1C.idea: 在适配视口的约束下继续把空间分给正文，检验解决办法和含义的改善是否足以抵消错误信息标识更频繁的断行。

s2A.idea: 在 P 和 s1B 之间试验解决办法栏宽度，寻找断词、行高和横向滚动距离之间更好的折中。

s2B.idea: 稍微收窄含义栏，减少总宽并让解决办法更早进入横向滚动范围；检查含义断行和行高是否仍可接受。

s2C.idea: 在适配视口的条件下进一步向解决办法分配宽度，检验较短表格能否抵消错误信息和含义栏更频繁的断行。

s3A.idea: 在 s2A 和 s1B 的解决办法宽度之间测试换行节点，观察能否减少词内断行而保持当前行高。

s3B.idea: 在两种适配方案之间折中，检查是否能兼顾较少的标识符断行和较短的解决办法单元格。

s3C.idea: 适配宽度下进一步优先查找键和含义，测试更完整的标识符是否值得解决办法列增加的高度。

contrast.idea: Equal-looking columns give the short numeric codes unnecessary space and starve the much longer solutions. Error identifiers also split, so both lookup and continuous reading suffer.

s2C.why: All columns are visible at once, and the remedy column gets useful priority. Error identifiers fracture across several lines, however, the error-message header wraps, and the narrow meaning column makes reading laborious.

contrast.why: The equal columns leave the lengthy remedies in extremely narrow, tall strips. Identifiers and technical terms break repeatedly, while the short code cells leave large empty areas beside each row.

vc_pref.why: Codes and error identifiers remain intact, and remedies have a workable reading width. Meanings still wrap into short lines, and the initial viewport cuts through that column while leaving the remedies offscreen.

d2r4A.why: All headers fit on one line and the complete table is accessible without horizontal scrolling. Error identifiers still split, and the narrow meaning and remedy columns produce long, difficult rows.

s2A.why: Whole error identifiers, relatively natural prose lines and consistent row heights make the full table easy to scan. On a phone, the initial view shows only part of the meaning and the remedy requires substantial horizontal scrolling.

ref_equal.why: The almost equal columns produce the same extremely tall remedy strips as B. Frequent breaks in identifiers and technical terms hinder lookup and reading, with extensive unused space in the code column.

ref_auto.why: Error identifiers stay whole and the initial viewport nearly contains the meaning column. The remedy remains both offscreen and very narrow, creating long rows and conspicuous empty space beside the shorter cells.

d3r3A.why: The full table gives meanings and remedies comfortable widths and keeps identifiers whole. A few rows are taller than their neighbors, and the phone view still requires considerable scrolling to reach the remedies.

d1r0C.why: The full table has clear identifiers, readable meanings and consistently sized rows. Its narrower remedy column needs more lines than E, while the initial viewport still exposes only part of the meaning.

acceptance.unsure: D is the strongest fitting compromise, but A gives the remedies more room and could be preferable when reading remedies matters more than preserving headers and identifiers. E is the strongest scrolling layout overall; H and I reduce the horizontal travel at the cost of somewhat longer remedies. No fitting layout is a strong publication example at this viewport width.

d3r3A.why: Error codes and identifiers remain intact, and the meaning and solution columns read comfortably in the full table. The first viewport shows only part of the meaning column, so reaching solutions requires substantial horizontal scrolling; a few rows also grow taller than their neighbours.

ref_auto.why: Identifiers stay whole, but the narrow meaning and solution columns produce many short lines and very tall rows. The solution is still offscreen initially, so the scrolling buys little relief from the cramped text.

s2C.why: All columns are visible at once and the wider solution column helps compared with the other fitting layouts. However, error identifiers break across several lines, the error-message header wraps, and both meaning and solution are fragmented into narrow text strips.

d2r4A.why: Headers fit on one line and error identifiers break less severely than in C, but the narrower solution column makes the already long rows substantially taller. Meaning and solution text are hard to read continuously.

s2A.why: Whole identifiers, relatively natural text lines and consistently compact rows make the full table easy to scan. The initial viewport nevertheless cuts through the meaning column and hides the solutions, which require a long horizontal scroll.

contrast.why: Equal-width columns leave the lengthy solutions in extremely narrow, tall blocks while short codes sit above large empty spaces. Identifiers and prose break repeatedly, making lookup and reading laborious despite all columns being onscreen.

ref_equal.why: The near-equal columns produce the same severe imbalance as F: fragmented identifiers and very long solution columns set against largely empty code cells. The whole width is visible, but each row is difficult to navigate.

vc_pref.why: Identifiers remain whole and the shorter scroll makes solutions easier to reach. The narrow meaning column breaks phrases frequently, while solution paragraphs still occupy up to eight lines and create tall, sparse rows.

d1r0C.why: The meaning column reads comfortably, identifiers remain whole, and regular rows make the table easy to scan in full. Solutions wrap more than in E, but the total horizontal travel is somewhat shorter; solutions remain hidden on first sight.

acceptance.unsure: C is the strongest fitting compromise for the long solutions, but its broken identifiers are a serious lookup drawback; D may be preferable when scanning error messages matters more than reading solutions. E is the strongest scrolling layout for continuous reading, though its large horizontal travel makes the choice between E and I dependent on how often readers move between codes and solutions.

ref_auto.why: 错误码和错误信息完整，但含义与解决办法都很窄，长段落被切成大量短行。首屏看不到解决办法，横向滚动后仍要阅读很高的行。

d2r4A.why: 四列都能在屏内看到，表头也完整，但错误信息中的标识符被拆开，含义列尤其狭窄；长解决办法使各行很高，跨行查找吃力。

ref_equal.why: 等宽列给短错误码留出多余空间，却把长解决办法挤成极细的文字带。标识符频繁断开，行非常高，查找和连续阅读都困难。

d3r3A.why: 完整视图中标识符整齐，含义和解决办法都有舒适的行宽，少数行高略有变化。手机首屏只显示前两列及部分含义，阅读解决办法需要较大幅度横向滚动。

s2A.why: 完整视图中的标识符清楚，正文断行较自然，七个数据行高度一致且紧凑。解决办法在首屏之外，较宽的表需要明显横向滚动。

s2C.why: 在屏内给解决办法更多宽度，缩短了表格，但错误信息表头换行，错误标识符被拆成多段，含义列也很窄，影响查找和阅读。

contrast.why: 与 C 的等宽分配几乎相同：错误码列过宽，解决办法列过窄，正文和标识符断裂严重，形成很长的纵向表格。

vc_pref.why: 错误码和错误信息易于扫描，解决办法的宽度比 A 实用得多，横向滚动距离也较适中。含义列仍偏窄，正文断行频繁；首屏看不到解决办法。

d1r0C.why: 含义列较宽，解决办法段落也便于阅读，数据行高度一致。完整错误标识符有利于查找，但首屏只显示部分含义，解决办法需要横向滚动才能看到。

acceptance.unsure: B 是适配屏宽组中较均衡的选择，但 F 的解决办法更宽、表格更短；两者都严重拆分标识符，均难称理想。滚动组中 E 的完整表格阅读体验最好，但 H 的滚动距离较短；实际偏好取决于读者在查找错误码和阅读解决办法之间切换的频率。

L05.why: Codes and message identifiers stay whole, but the narrow solution column produces long, dense blocks and tall rows, leaving conspicuous empty space beneath the shorter meanings. The initial viewport shows the lookup keys but little of their explanations.

L03.why: The wide code column leaves unused space while nearly every message identifier breaks inside the identifier. Those breaks make the second lookup key difficult to scan, despite the orderly explanatory columns.

s2A.why: Both lookup columns keep their codes and identifiers whole, and the broad solution column keeps the long instructions reasonably compact. Rows align consistently; some prose still breaks awkwardly, and reaching the solutions requires substantial horizontal scrolling.

L01.why: Codes and message identifiers remain intact, with a regular row rhythm. Extra width in the first two columns leaves less of the meaning visible initially and slightly less space for the prose than in D.

L07.why: Every numeric error code is split, and the code header wraps too. This damages the table's central lookup task even though the message identifiers and solution text have useful space.

L04.why: Numeric codes remain whole, but several important message identifiers split, sometimes leaving a single letter on the next line. The excess space in the code column would be more useful in the message column.

landscape.unsure: All supplied candidates scroll; there is no fitting layout to evaluate or select. D, E and F are relatively close, and their ordering depends partly on how much weight is given to prose wrapping versus the initial viewport.

L08.why: Error codes remain intact and the rows are orderly, but INVALID_CREDENTIAL breaks before its final letter. The initial viewport shows only part of the meaning column; solutions require substantial scrolling.

L09.why: Every numeric error code breaks after four digits, and the first header wraps. The message identifiers stay intact, but broken lookup keys make scanning unnecessarily difficult.

s2A.why: Both error codes and message identifiers fit on one line, and the meaning and solution columns have a clear, consistent rhythm. Reading the solution still requires a long horizontal scroll.

L10.why: Numeric codes remain intact, but INVALID_CREDENTIAL and INVALID_APPSECRET each leave a final letter on a second line, impairing message lookup. The rest of the grid is orderly.

L13.why: The wider meaning column gives prose more room, but several message identifiers split across lines. Those identifiers are prominent lookup targets, so the tradeoff is costly.

L12.why: Several message identifiers split, while the code column has spare space. The uniform rows and generous solution column remain readable once reached by scrolling.

L14.why: Codes and message identifiers remain whole, supporting lookup. The narrower meaning column creates shorter, sometimes awkward final lines and leaves less of that column visible initially.

L11.why: Each five-digit error code breaks after three digits, and the code header wraps. Whole message identifiers help, but the fragmented numeric keys obstruct the table's primary lookup task.

landscape.unsure: All eight examples scroll; no viewport-fitting layout was supplied, so a fitting layout cannot be selected or assessed. C and G are close: C gives meaning more room, while G gives message identifiers more breathing room. s2A.why: Error codes and error identifiers stay whole, and the meaning and solution columns have a useful balance. The solution requires substantial horizontal scrolling, and some prose breaks remain awkward.

L13.why: Several lookup identifiers split across lines, including INVALID_CREDENTIAL and API_UNAUTHORIZED. The wider meaning column helps prose, but those breaks make scanning error messages harder.

L08.why: INVALID_CREDENTIAL leaves a single L on the next line. The extra width given to error codes does little for lookup and leaves less room for the other columns.

L14.why: Codes and error identifiers remain intact and easy to scan. The narrower meaning column produces more cramped wrapping and short final lines than A.
